profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: Prior degree for Ecotourism
requirements.details: The academic route requires a Level 8 science honours qualification in environmental science, environmental management, life sciences or a related field.

requirements.label: Prior qualification for Climate Change and Sustainable Development
requirements.details: The programme lists an honours bachelor’s degree or postgraduate diploma at NCQF Level 8. Accepted fields include environmental management, environmental science, social sciences, life sciences and related disciplines.

requirements.label: Academic entry to Construction Project Management
requirements.details: The academic route starts at NCQF Level 7, a bachelor’s degree or an equivalent qualification. The table gives no compulsory first-degree discipline.

requirements.label: Previous study for Urban Planning and Design
requirements.details: Present a Level 7 bachelor’s degree in urban planning and design or a related field.

requirements.label: Previous study for Environmental Health
requirements.details: Present an NCQF Level 7 bachelor’s degree in environmental health or a related field.

requirements.label: Previous study for Real Estate Finance and Investment
requirements.details: Hold a bachelor’s degree at NCQF Level 7 or higher from a recognised institution in real estate, property studies, finance and investment, or a related discipline.

requirements.label: Previous study for Housing Administration
requirements.details: Present a Level 7 bachelor’s degree from a recognised, fully accredited institution. A built environment or related degree is preferred.

requirements.label: Prior degree for Early Childhood Development
requirements.details: The academic route requires a Level 7 bachelor’s degree in early childhood or infant education from a recognised education and training provider.

requirements.label: Educational leadership experience
requirements.details: The master’s entry table specifies at least two years of relevant work in an educational setting.

profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: Credit transfer and prior learning
requirements.details: Eligible applicants can use the university’s processes for assessment of prior learning or the accumulation and transfer of credit.

requirements.label: Graduate entry through prior learning
requirements.details: Candidates below the standard academic threshold can have prior learning assessed under national policy.

requirements.label: Alternative graduate entry with experience
requirements.details: Applicants with a degree in another subject and at least five years of relevant work experience may be considered by the Academic Affairs Board, which may require an entrance interview.

requirements.label: Accelerated graduate progression
requirements.details: Holders of the postgraduate diploma in Educational Leadership and Management may complete the master’s programme in two semesters (12 months).

profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: Graduate transfer credit
requirements.details: Applicants transferring from another institution can seek to carry forward credits under the national credit accumulation and transfer policy.

profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: School qualifications for Real Estate
requirements.details: For the BCom, the 2026 guide lists NCQF Level 4 (for example BGCSE), or equivalent, including a pass in English.

requirements.label: Science subjects for Safety, Health and Environmental Management
requirements.details: The school route requires at least 36 BGCSE points or equivalent, English at D or higher and a credit at C in science, mathematics or statistics.

requirements.label: School subjects for Landscape Architecture
requirements.details: The BGCSE route requires at least 36 points or equivalent with an English pass at grade D and a Mathematics credit at grade C.

requirements.label: School or vocational certificate for Quantity Surveying Honours
requirements.details: Present at least Certificate IV at NCQF Level 4 in technical and vocational education and training or general education, or an equivalent qualification.

requirements.label: Qualification for the Real Estate certificate
requirements.details: The 2026 programme table lists Certificate IV at NCQF Level 4, in either general education or technical and vocational education and training.

requirements.label: School results for Education (General)
requirements.details: The school-leaver route requires at least five BGCSE credits or equivalent, including a pass in English.

requirements.label: Certificate IV and Certificate V pathways
requirements.details: The normal routes list a Level 4 Certificate IV in general education with English (or equivalent), and a recognised Level 5 Certificate V in Early Childhood Education. The official programme page describes a different credit load for each entry qualification.

requirements.label: Qualifications for vocational teacher training
requirements.details: Applicants may enter with a diploma or degree in a vocational subject. A vocational certificate is another route when accompanied by at least three years of teaching or training experience.

profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: Confirm which Real Estate degree entry rules apply
requirements.details: The undated course page lists 36 BGCSE points including English D, a relevant diploma alternative, or two years of relevant work subject to board approval. It also lists 31 points for orphans, vulnerable children and other qualifying groups. The 2026 guide instead describes Level 4 with an English pass and prior-learning or transfer provisions. Confirm the applicable route for the intended intake.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Bachelor of Commerce in Real Estate · admissions

requirements.label: Consideration for designated applicant groups
requirements.details: The separate programme page gives 31 BGCSE points for orphans and vulnerable children and other qualifying special-interest groups. Its intake year is unspecified.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Bachelor of Science in Safety, Health and Environmental Management · admissions

requirements.label: Confirm the Real Estate certificate entry route
requirements.details: The undated course page gives two BGCSE credits plus subject passes, or at least two years of relevant work experience subject to Academic Affairs Board review. The 2026 guide specifies Certificate IV or access under prior-learning and transfer policies. Confirm the rule for the chosen intake.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Certificate in Real Estate · admissions

requirements.label: Early Childhood Education degree entry
requirements.details: The programme page specifies 36 BGCSE points or equivalent, including at least D in English and the applicable subject passes.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood Education · admissions

requirements.label: Designated applicant groups in Early Childhood Education
requirements.details: The entry page gives 31 BGCSE points for orphans and vulnerable children and other eligible special-interest groups.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood Education · admissions

requirements.label: School results for subject teacher education
requirements.details: The school route calls for five or more BGCSE credits or equivalent, including an English pass.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Bachelor of Education in English Language · admissions

requirements.label: School results for Mathematics Education
requirements.details: Present five or more BGCSE credits or their equivalent, including an English pass and a mathematics credit.

source.title: BA ISAGO · Bachelor of Education in Mathematics · admissions

requirements.label: Practising teacher qualifications for the professional diploma
requirements.details: Applicants must be practising teachers with at least three years of teaching experience and a Junior Certificate, BGCSE or equivalent. A Primary School Teacher’s Certificate or equivalent is normally needed.

source.title: BA ISAGO · National Professional Diploma in Education (NPDE) · admissions

requirements.label: Evidence of current teaching employment
requirements.details: All applicants must submit an official letter from their head of school confirming their current employment.

source.title: BA ISAGO · National Professional Diploma in Education (NPDE) · admissions

requirements.label: Confirm the available intake
requirements.details: The university publishes a dedicated programme page, but the award is absent from its short 2026 programme list. Confirm availability directly before applying.

source.title: BA ISAGO 2026 Programme List · Faculty of Education, p. 2

requirements.label: Exemption from individual courses
requirements.details: Students may receive exemptions for selected courses if approved under institutional regulations.

profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: Alternative entry to the Real Estate certificate
requirements.details: Applicants missing the usual certificate can be considered under prior-learning and credit-transfer policies at the training provider or national level.

requirements.label: Entry with a Secondary Education diploma
requirements.details: A Diploma in Secondary Education or its equivalent from a recognised institution in the SADC region or elsewhere is an alternative qualification.

requirements.label: Mature entry to Education (General)
requirements.details: Applicants with at least three years of relevant work experience may be considered. Prior learning may be assessed for mature entry.

requirements.label: Block release with a diploma
requirements.details: The guide gives a two- to three-year block-release route for diploma holders.

requirements.label: Diploma-holder progression
requirements.details: The guide gives a 30-month block-release or part-time route for diploma holders.

requirements.label: Mature entry with employment evidence
requirements.details: Applicants using mature entry need NCQF Level 4, at least three years of relevant work and a reference letter confirming that experience.

requirements.label: Recognition of vocational competence
requirements.details: Applicants can demonstrate competence in a vocational field through approved assessment of prior learning or recognition of current competence under BA ISAGO regulations.

profiles.notes: Each requirement identifies its applicable qualifications, applicant group and official source.

requirements.label: Qualifications for Educational Leadership and Management
requirements.details: The school lists a recognised first degree in a teaching-related subject (arts, science or technology). Its programme page also allows the postgraduate diploma in Educational Leadership and Management as an alternative.

requirements.label: Degree for Curriculum Design and Development
requirements.details: Present a completed degree in education, social sciences, business studies, science or humanities.

requirements.details: Applicants need a completed education degree or an equivalent qualification.

requirements.details: Applicants missing the academic qualifications may be considered with at least three years of relevant experience. The university may assess prior learning.

requirements.label: Mature entry to Mathematics Education
requirements.details: Applicants below standard entry need at least three years of relevant experience for consideration by the Academic Affairs Board. Mature-entry assessment uses the university’s prior-learning policy.

requirements.label: Prior learning in place of the Primary School Teacher’s Certificate
requirements.details: Applicants without this teaching certificate may seek recognition of prior learning, subject to the Academic Affairs Board’s approval.

requirements.label: Advanced standing in Mathematics Education
requirements.details: The university lists Year 2 for applicants with a relevant primary education diploma in mathematics and Year 3 with a relevant secondary education diploma in mathematics, from a tertiary teacher education institution or equivalent.
